title: Verified Record Cards
mission: Convert pulled records into reusable proof cards for the tracker system.
boundary: A verified record card proves only the record it describes. It does not prove guilt, motive, knowledge, conspiracy, passenger identity, hidden control, or wrongdoing beyond the record text.

verifiedCards.title: EFTA01104262/EFTA01104263 Connections Web source file
verifiedCards.recordDate: source file dated by Bates range; page content includes 2015/current map labels
verifiedCards.evidenceGrade: A for source-map existence; C for relationship implications
verifiedCards.recordShows: The map file exists, contains visible nodes, color/label lanes and a two-page map structure for EFTA01104262/EFTA01104263.
verifiedCards.recordDoesNotShow: It does not prove criminal conduct, knowledge, payments, travel, meetings or guilt.
claimsSupported: source-map can feed people/wealth tracker as an open lead
claimsNotSupported: verified relationship type beyond the map label
verifiedCards.nextRecordToPull: For each node, pull independent court, financial, public statement, institution or counter-source record.
verifiedCards.confidenceImpact: Creates A-grade source existence but keeps relationship/misconduct claims at C until independently verified.
verifiedCards.boundary: Map node is a document item, not a verdict.

verifiedCards.title: DOJ Epstein disclosure route
verifiedCards.recordShows: The official government disclosure route exists and can be used to locate release context and public file sets.
verifiedCards.recordDoesNotShow: It does not validate every interpretation of each released document.
claimsNotSupported: interpretive claims not supported by document text
verifiedCards.nextRecordToPull: Attach dataset number, release note, file title and redaction boundary to each Epstein source card.
verifiedCards.confidenceImpact: A-grade source route; claim grade depends on individual file content.
verifiedCards.boundary: Government source route does not replace document-level classification.

verifiedCards.title: Top 50 Evidence Pull List created
verifiedCards.sourceType: internal research workflow / public source-route index
verifiedCards.recordShows: The site now has a structured list of fifty source routes, each with proof limits, next action and confidence impact.
verifiedCards.recordDoesNotShow: It does not prove any external claim until a listed record is pulled and classified.
verifiedCards.nextRecordToPull: Convert top priority pulls into verified record cards as records are actually checked.
verifiedCards.confidenceImpact: Turns open research into operational tasks; does not upgrade external claims alone.
verifiedCards.boundary: Pull list is a task list, not proof.

verifiedCards.title: Evidence Task Engine created
verifiedCards.evidenceGrade: A for internal task workflow existence
verifiedCards.recordShows: The tracker has explicit task fields: next pull, source route, evidence class, proof limits, status and confidence change.
verifiedCards.recordDoesNotShow: It does not prove external wrongdoing or verify any external record by itself.
verifiedCards.nextRecordToPull: Move individual tasks from open to pulled/verified/rejected when a source record is checked.
verifiedCards.confidenceImpact: A for workflow; C remains for open external leads.
verifiedCards.boundary: Task status is workflow status, not a verdict.

verifiedCards.title: Wrongdoing Tracker case engine created
verifiedCards.evidenceGrade: A for internal case engine existence
verifiedCards.recordShows: The site separates confirmed findings, alleged misconduct, institutional failure, money movement, legal suppression, reputation management, transport/logistics evidence and open leads.
verifiedCards.recordDoesNotShow: It does not prove any named external wrongdoing without source-specific records.
verifiedCards.nextRecordToPull: Attach court findings, enforcement actions, settlements, institutional reviews and public responses to the case lanes.
verifiedCards.confidenceImpact: Makes the tracker safer and more precise; does not upgrade external leads alone.

verifiedCards.title: Case Status Dashboard created
verifiedCards.recordShows: The tracker now counts open, pulled, verified, rejected, needs-counter-source and privacy-blocked lanes.
verifiedCards.recordDoesNotShow: It does not verify external claims or prove wrongdoing.
verifiedCards.nextRecordToPull: Start moving cards from open to pulled and verified as source records are classified.
verifiedCards.confidenceImpact: A for operational status; external claims remain unchanged until evidence pulled.
verifiedCards.boundary: Operational status is not a legal finding.

verifiedCards.title: Aviation Evidence Policy page created
verifiedCards.recordShows: The site uses historical transport records, court exhibits, registry context and privacy flags only.
verifiedCards.recordDoesNotShow: It does not provide or endorse live personal movement tracking, passenger identity claims or private address publication.
verifiedCards.nextRecordToPull: Only add transport records when a court exhibit, released log or official context record exists.

verifiedCards.title: Dark Speculation Lab enriched claim cards
verifiedCards.evidenceGrade: A for claim workflow existence; C/X for unverified claims
verifiedCards.recordShows: Each speculation claim lane can show research brief, support standard, falsification test, risk rating and source routes.
verifiedCards.recordDoesNotShow: It does not make speculation true.
verifiedCards.nextRecordToPull: Attach one best proving source and one counter-source to each high-risk claim.
verifiedCards.confidenceImpact: Prevents speculation from being treated as proof.
